Pencil.caption: STAY SAFE
Pencil.full:
STAY SAFE 
CORONA/COVID-19
Art inspired by @adamelmahjoub 
The mighty world falling before pandemic of a tiny virus. Sounds almost unrealistic. So many people getting infected so quick.
World economy and trade majorly affected. The truth is the virus isn't so lethal , more than half the infected have been recovered and slowly it is getting in control. But still it has mortality rate of less immune people, just like other diseases. So stop panicking and making situation worse. This doesn't mean u have to be careless and avoid prevention procedures.
Wash your hands often with soap, keep your hands off ur mouth ,eyes and nose, avoid crowded places , only travel if absolute necessity and wear mask (preferably N-95 - not the one sold in roadside) 
You may be immune to the disease symptoms but u might be a carrier and infect to other unfortunate People.

Prevention is way better than non existing cure.
.
